en: The Non-Causal-with-Causal Dyad, the Wholesome Triplet.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root, nor accompanied by a root, nor wholesome, a state that is a root, accompanied by a root, and wholesome arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root, nor accompanied by a root, nor unwholesome, a state that is a root, accompanied by a root, and unwholesome arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not a root-cause, not rootless, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is not a root-cause, rootless, and indeterminate, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition, one; under the predominance-condition, one … pe … under the non-disappearance-condition, one.
